  • First quarter fiscal 2027: adjusted EBITDAAdjusted EBITDA expected to decline between 28% and 33% year-over-year
  • Fiscal year 2027: net salesNet sales expected to decline between 13% and 17% year-over-year
  • Fiscal year 2027: adjusted EBITDAAdjusted EBITDA expected to decline between 9% and 14% year-over-year
